dismissed.reason: stronger-than-source: The guide's "Show only the last four digits of the account number" is an ordinary content directive, like "Keep values short" (marked recommended). Here "only" says which digits to show; it is not an absolute that applies everywhere. No package fact enforces masking, so [required] overstates it.
dismissed.by: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), Penny run run_24bf5718, sorting the flags; for Astra and Marcin to confirm
dismissed.why: The sentence has no condition, so its “only” applies to every card that shows an account number, and the pack allows required for an absolute whose scope is everywhere. The guide’s own Do & Don’t pair says the same (“Mask the account number” against “The full account number”: “Anyone near the screen can read it”). Unlike “Keep values short”, it is an exact limit with a privacy reason, not a matter of degree. The entry calls it a content rule; it does not claim the package enforces it.
